The '''Republic Stellar Cartography Service''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that dealt with the mapping of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. It frequently bought [[Starship/Legends|starships]] build by the shipwrights of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Starship Manufacturing}}</ref>
